title: Asuran armor
wikitext:
[[Asuran armor]] can be crafted by [[Klub]] in [[Rata Sum]] after reaching rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the [[Asura rank|Asura title track]]. Klub also crafts three types of [[Common armor#Headgear|glasses]].
